findings.ref: REQ-002; AC-027; declared check-risk-upgrade.sh and check-risk-upgrade.ps1
findings.note: Supplied malformed fragments can bypass fail-closed validation. Both implementations treat a present but falsy non-array upgrade_reasons value such as null, 0, false, or an empty string as absent. They also validate upgrade_reasons only for eligible:false entries, so malformed values on eligible:true entries are ignored. Require any present upgrade_reasons field to be an array of valid non-empty strings for every entry and add matching twin-runtime fixtures.

The verification contract is not valid for a passing gate: required regression and placeholder-scan checks are recorded passes:false, no required human acceptance for the placeholder findings is included, and the contract explicitly discloses that spec_revision is stale. Resolve or authorize the failures and issue a fresh independently verified contract bound to the current specification.

The protected-file HUMAN APPLY STEP remains incomplete. The report states that the live protected scripts and policy were not updated, while Done When requires runner-based application plus manifest and post-copy hash verification before completion.
